purpose: Test one transparent causal decision tree learned only from the opened E1526-E1528 training cohort: freeze a workload-complexity band before any burst, classify the first burst from raw arrivals at age five, then dispatch an exact persistent native expert on its own frontier with the unchanged same-cohort Nash safety certificate.

adaptive_training_disclosure.consulted_cohort: opened adaptive training seeds E1526-E1528 only
consulted_results: frozen V142 baseline per-seed throughput and both QPR conventions
V144 and V147 candidate throughput and both QPR conventions
V147 result-blind causal arrival, native-frontier, dispatch, and solver diagnostics
fitted_elements: the fixed three-by-three expert route table
the low-complexity Greedy-to-FaaSRank age-50 phase rule
the complexity-specific quiet and age-one-to-four warmup experts

first_principles_diagnosis.v147_integrity: All nine V147 candidate runs were attempt-1 QC passes with exact route-native frontier capture, dispatch, references, ledgers, pairing, and a result-blind audit; the failure was scientific rather than technical.
first_principles_diagnosis.v147_failure: The V145 persistence route used Greedy before age 55 and switched too late. Sustained and pulse paths accumulated irreversible placement and container-state effects before the intended expert was selected; spike remained an exact Greedy tie and therefore failed strict superiority.
first_principles_diagnosis.causal_separability: In the opened training cohort, the maximum all-unscheduled common-HPA feasible-player count during the first 80 consecutive windows was 6-9 for E1528, 13-16 for E1526, and 29-37 for E1527 across all three scenarios. At first-episode age five, the five-frame raw-arrival rate divided by the frozen preceding-80-frame raw-arrival rate was approximately 2.70-2.75 for sustained, 3.56-3.67 for pulse, and 4.46-4.56 for spike.
first_principles_diagnosis.conclusion: A causal tree can classify the three training environment-complexity bands before the earliest observed burst and classify burst intensity five frames after the first detected episode without reading seed, scenario, future state, or any completed-request outcome. This is an adaptively fitted hypothesis requiring untouched confirmation.

hypotheses.primary: Early causal routing to a complexity-and-intensity-specific exact native expert avoids V147's late-switch path dependence and strictly exceeds every frozen concurrent V142 baseline mean on throughput and both QPR conventions in all three scenarios.
hypotheses.secondary: The unchanged same-selected-frontier Nash certificate can only replace the chosen native assignment when readiness-service maximum is nonworse, readiness-service sum is strictly lower, and immutable-baseline paper welfare is nonworse.
hypotheses.falsification: The sole V148 arm is falsified if any result-blind contract fails or any one of the same nine strict scenario-by-metric training gates fails.

information_boundary.fail_closed: Any frame discontinuity, incomplete 80-frame feature history, arithmetic overflow, lifecycle mismatch, native frontier mismatch, incomplete selected assignment, dispatch mismatch, unavailable or nonfinite service/welfare certificate, provenance mismatch, or failed blind audit rejects reveal. Before the 80-frame complexity feature is complete, route to Hash.

complexity_feature.source: maximum all-unscheduled common-HPA placement-feasible player count over frames 0-79 inclusive
complexity_feature.freeze_time: after the 80th consecutive scheduler window and before any V142 E3 burst interval

intensity_feature.source: checked integer ratio of raw first-seen arrivals in first-episode frames age 1-5 to the frozen 80 frames immediately preceding the detected first episode
intensity_feature.evaluation_time: exactly once at first-episode age five
intensity_feature.comparison: compare recent5*80 against baseline80*5 using checked integer arithmetic

low.sustained_intensity: greedy through episode age 49 inclusive, then faasrank
low.spike_intensity: greedy through episode age 49 inclusive, then faasrank

fixed_route_table.route_persistence: After age-five classification the branch is immutable for the run; recurrent episodes do not reclassify or read outcomes. The low sustained/spike age-50 phase transition uses only first-episode age.

route_native_frontier_contract.greedy: CollectTaskConfig::All; exact duplicate-free feasible native command order and assigned nodes
route_native_frontier_contract.faasrank: CollectTaskConfig::PreAllDone; exact duplicate-free feasible native command order and assigned nodes; no tail fill
route_native_frontier_contract.load_least: CollectTaskConfig::All; exact duplicate-free feasible native command order and assigned nodes
route_native_frontier_contract.hiku: CollectTaskConfig::All; exact duplicate-free feasible native command order and assigned nodes
route_native_frontier_contract.jiagu: CollectTaskConfig::All; exact duplicate-free feasible native command order and assigned nodes

route_native_frontier_contract.persistent_lifecycle: Advance all seven native shadows exactly once per scheduling window on their own native frontiers, independent of selection.
route_native_frontier_contract.dispatch: Dispatch exactly the selected expert's complete native assignment unless the unchanged Nash proposal on that same selected cohort passes the service-maximum, service-sum, and paper-welfare certificate.
route_native_frontier_contract.nash_acceptance: Proposal complete on the exact selected native cohort; readiness-service maximum nonworse; readiness-service sum strictly lower; immutable-baseline paper welfare nonworse.

treatment.nash_guard: unchanged V147 complete same-selected-frontier strict service-and-welfare certificate

training_design.independent_unit: one frozen V142 workload tape and environment seed
training_design.candidate_run_order_rule: Use one seeded permutation of the nine frozen cells; never reorder after a result or failure.

selection_rule.qpr_definition: per-run fixed-window throughput divided by drained-cohort mean latency and cost per completed request
selection_rule.per_scenario_per_metric: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the maximum frozen concurrent V142 baseline mean and candidate-minus-each-baseline is strictly positive on at least two of three paired seeds
selection_rule.zero_completion: retain every run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero is zero; no imputation or seed replacement
selection_rule.confirmation: A pass authorizes only a separately preregistered untouched E1497-E1516 confirmation cohort; failure retires V148 without seed replacement.

logging_and_blind_audit.per_window: Log consecutive feature history validity; complexity freeze time/value/band; first-episode start/age; baseline80 and recent5 counts; checked intensity comparisons and band; selected route/reason/phase; all seven native frontier player counts, command counts, order hashes, and lifecycle counts; exact selected dispatch equality; Nash certificate evidence; and existing solver/reference observations.
logging_and_blind_audit.blind_audit: Before reveal validate the exact nine-run product, attempt-1 QC, zero quarantine, ledgers, runtime consensus, frozen pairings/tapes/SLA, nine new references, exact feature arithmetic, one-time freezes, route-table identity, seven route-specific native frontier equalities, complete selected assignment, selected dispatch, Nash certificate, and zero parsed candidate performance summaries.

execution_policy.technical_retry_policy: same frozen seed, tape, config, binary, and order only under the existing preregistered technical-failure rules
